tasks.label: Code Edit
tasks.description: Modify source code, configuration, tests, or build files.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to implement, fix, refactor, or change files.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User only asks for critique, explanation, or review.

tasks.label: Code Review
tasks.description: Review source changes for correctness, regressions, maintainability, and missing tests.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to inspect existing code or a diff and identify issues.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to implement changes directly.

tasks.label: Root Cause Debugging
tasks.description: Investigate a failure to identify the underlying cause before proposing or applying fixes.

classifier.useWhen: User reports failing tests, crashes, locks, regressions, or unexpected behavior.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User already knows the fix and asks to apply it.

tasks.label: Test Writing
tasks.description: Create or update tests for code behavior.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for tests, coverage, regression proof, or TDD.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks only to inspect code without changes.

tasks.label: Code Refactor
tasks.description: Improve structure without intended behavior changes.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to simplify, reorganize, deduplicate, or improve maintainability.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for new product behavior.

tasks.label: Code Explanation
tasks.description: Explain code behavior, architecture, or implementation details.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how code works or why it behaves a certain way.

tasks.label: Code Migration
tasks.description: Move code across APIs, frameworks, versions, or platforms.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to upgrade, port, or migrate implementation.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User only asks for conceptual comparison.

tasks.label: Code Generation
tasks.description: Create new code from a specification.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to scaffold, generate, or create a new implementation.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to review existing code only.

tasks.label: Dependency Update
tasks.description: Update package dependencies, lockfiles, or version constraints.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to update packages or dependency versions.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for supply-chain risk review only.

tasks.label: Code Configuration
tasks.description: Modify project, build, lint, test, or runtime configuration files.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to configure code tooling or project settings.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for production runtime operations only.
